resolvedFindings.resolution: Integration requires zero exit, no error, no timeout and exact command/transcript.
Complete progress tuples match the iteration inventory, enforce zero drops and monotone fresh report/store bounds, and match final fixed reports/stored count.
Every recorded scalar progress count lies on the scalarWalks*1024 launch grid and ends at the exact total.

limitations: These 106 synthetic cases validate checker acceptance/rejection logic only.
